notes.title: Patch Note #4
notes.content:
Without further ado, here is the list of changes coming with this patch!

[list]
[*] Some small visual/UI fix
[*] Fixed a bug where you could attach two parts together even though they were not snapped together
[*] QoL the item you have in hand should now snap in a more intuitive way, trying to maintain as much as possible of its rotation
[*] Fixed deckchair model in level 2-21
[*] Fixed color symbols in level 2-20
[*] You can now tell the game which type of controller you use in the settings, in case the auto detect is failing to do so
[*] Levels where you have earned the 4th star are now green in the level selector
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note #3
notes.content:
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[h3]We fixed a number of small bugs that would interrupt of softlock your games. [/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a hitbox bug that would cause items to go through teleporters
[*] Fixed a bug that would make 
[*] Fixed a typo in English that would spell "tranfer" instead of "transfer"
[*] Fixed a bug on Linux that would cause symbols on showers not to be displayed in world 2. 
[*] Fixed a bug that would allow to sell the cat tree very far away from the selling zone
[*] Fixed a bug that would occur on outlines when picking up pillows
[*] Fixed a bug that would allow to put a nail in an item without another item being snapped to it. 
[*] Fixed a bug in level 1-19 that caused a softlock because of flying over the conveyor belt. 
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[h3]We improved little things in the game to give you a better experience. This category can apply to level design, furniture design, score balancing and QoL. [/h3]

[list]
[*] We changed the backrest of the rocking chair (R0xxx1ng ch41r) to make it more separable from the seat. 
[*] We added a "back to main" button in the lobby so you don't have to use escape menu. The game will ask you if you're sure. 
[*] Changed the position in which the TV stand (T1V1) plank is held so that it is more comfortable to snap things to it. 
[*] We've changed the pattern of the cushions on the deckchair (D3ckch41r) and reduce their number so that it's easier to describe and chose from.
[*] We've changed the couch (C0uch) pillows so that they are easier to tell apart in their shape AND in their pattern.
[*] We've added an indication in the instructions to show which part is "central" in each piece of furniture. This is the part that is "sold" when you sell your furniture. 
[*] We've increased the speed at which you move in the water by default, and we've increased the degree of control you have once in the water (speeding up, slowing down, etc.). 
[*] We've increased the distance at which one WeirdoZ can catch another in the water from the shore. 
[/list]

All these changes are available on PC, mac and linux.

notes.title: Patch Note #1 - Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hey guys! 

First of all, thank you all for playing KallaX, we hope you enjoy it very much. If you do, do not hesitate to leave us a review!
If you encounter difficulties with the game, please use [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1818280/discussions/]KallaX forum[/url] or our [url=https://discord.gg/KwQ32EYS4a]Discord[/url]! We will be more than happy to help you with any trouble you would come accross! 

We listened to your feedback and here are things we did in this [b]new update[/b]: 

[list]
[*] We made the game more accessible to more casual players. Not everyone wants to play KallaX in a very focused or competitive manner so we balanced some levels. Note that we are going to balance levels during this week and the next depending on feedback we receive. 
[*] You can know chose the display screen you want the game to be on in the game's settings. 
[*] When an item is snapped to a piece of furniture, controls reminder are placed near that item instead of near the character. This controls reminder reminds you that you can change the item orientation when it is snapped. This should make the life of new players easier. 
[*] We know most of you are not quite there yet (but soon!) so we added a new achievement for earning 4 stars on every level.
[/list]

We are now working on a better user interface for end-of-level-screens and, as said earlier, balancing the game! 

[i]We heard you when you said that it was frustrating to have lag when playing when a friend in a different country: there's nothing we can do about that, it's about ping and your internet connection. Servers are Steam's and not ours and we have absolutely no control over that. We're very sorry that you cannot experience this game with your friends abroad though and we do not blame you if you wanted to get a refund. [/i]

Have a great day and enjoy the game! 

PS: Steam cards should appear soon ;) 

The Unexpected Team

notes.title: Steam Next Fest: WeirdoZ incoming!
notes.content:
Our Steam Next Fest demo will be available from [b]June 19 to 26[/b] @ 10 AM PT / 7 PM CET

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42462508/f55533b945c9531cf797dabaa174163a920a3176.jpg[/img]

You'll be able to play the first ten levels of the game from 2 to 6 players!

All the progress you've made will be saved when you purchase the game when it's released, very soon ;) 

[b]A little extra:[/b] there are even Steam achievements linked to this demo. Completing it and getting three stars in all levels will be synonymous with 100%! 

The game will be available in [b]English and French[/b], but we're planning many other languages for the release! Don't hesitate to comment if you'd like your language to be included - we'll do our best to accommodate all players! 

We hope you have a great time on KallaX. Don't forget you can join our discord to share your impressions of the game and maybe even take part in our beta tests! 

See you soon!
